后台任务不能派发通用子任务: Background tasks cannot delegate general-purpose subtasks.
后台任务只能读取自身或管理直接关联的任务: Background tasks may only read themselves or manage their directly linked tasks.
父任务执行已失效，不能继续派发: The parent execution is no longer valid; delegation stopped.
任务委派已达到最大深度: The task delegation depth limit has been reached.
父任务已达到子任务数量上限: The parent task has reached its subtask limit.
父任务剩余预算不足以委派: The parent task has insufficient budget for delegation.
任务交付事件不能改写为用户消息，只能取消本次唤醒: Task delivery events cannot be edited into user messages; this wake-up can only be cancelled.
社交委派的原操作不能改写，请取消后重新派发: An existing social operation cannot be rewritten. Cancel it and delegate a new task.
原社交委派记录已丢失或暂不可读取；已停止重新派发，请先核验实际发送结果。: The original social task record is missing or unavailable. Automatic resubmission stopped; verify the actual delivery first.
社交工作已持久化派发；通过 manage_task 查询结果，父任务可等待该任务: The social task was durably accepted. Use manage_task to read its result; a parent task can wait for it.
委派尚未确认停止，请稍后再删除任务记录: The delegation has not confirmed stopping. Wait before deleting its task record.
